G41 readings stated before any restrict line is written, changing no rule: (5) a later canvas or emblem planned while building is the bound only where no record of the room comes before it in its lines already ruled; where one does, the order shows (touhou, pathofexile, pitt); (6) carrying the whole canvas on (a poster, a skin, r/place remade in a game) is carrying the work on, as pcmasterrace-070's poster was ruled (kerbalspaceprogram, globaloffensive); (7) a condition that a proposal was not carried out (a print offered, an image proposed for the sidebar) is held by P13's statement, which counts carrying on proposed, decided or done (G25): a specification naming P13 (chile, habs); (8) a retelling of how members worked or defended is P12's record (G40 reading 4), so a post that retells and then keeps the sub, the chat or a tie shows the order in its words (AvoArmy, quebec, radiohead); (9) the end marked alone ('its over') is not a record of what happened (G40 reading 1), so it opens no order (aeskwadraat, fivenightsatfreddys); (10) the mechanism in words needs the carrying act to take the recorded work itself (image, logo, sprite, design) into a banner, sidebar, avatar, later canvas or remake, in reply, in its thread or in one post; a next-time wish, a tie, the sub or chat kept, or a later canvas named without the work, after a record, is the order; (11) a remake, a print or a tie before the close and before the room's first record is carry first; those before hour 61 are D3a-20's forms, noted in the census. Two slips in the written instantiate lines, found by this check: pitt-039 was ruled the bound without reading 1's check, which finds pitt-013's c0081 (a retelling, h+54.21) before c0082 (h+56.33), so it is re-ruled accept (the order); DestinyTheGame-052 was classed one end, but c0334 and c0335 are one post (h+79.94), cleaned images and flairs at once, so it is re-ruled reject as one act.
